sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Sector breadth remains narrow with only 2 of 11 groups all-green, anchored by dominant, sustained strength in Technology.

Technology continues to lead the market, maintaining sustained top-3 rank across the 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons alongside a peak momentum score of 0.950. Healthcare (0.733) and Energy (0.667) follow in momentum, while defensive and rate-sensitive sectors sit at the bottom, marked by Utilities fading to a market-low momentum score of 0.033. 

Rotational activity over the last five sessions was muted across the board, defined solely by Consumer Defensive edging up one spot to rank 6 while Financial slipped one spot to rank 7. Consumer Cyclical remains pinned at the bottom of the YTD rankings (rank 11) with weak momentum (0.250).

## Strength
- Technology is the standout leader, ranking as the sole sustained strong group across 1-, 3-, and 6-month ranks, posting a 0.950 momentum score (rank 2 YTD).
- Breadth remains constrained, with only 2 of 11 sectors qualifying as all-green across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD: Technology and Communication Services (momentum 0.650).
- Healthcare and Energy round out the upper tier of momentum leaders at 0.733 (rank 5 YTD) and 0.667 (rank 1 YTD), respectively.

## Movers & Momentum
- Consumer Defensive was the sole gainer over the past five sessions, climbing +1 spot to rank 6 with a 0.417 momentum score.
- Financial was the lone declining mover over the five-session window, falling -1 spot to rank 7 with a 0.483 momentum score.
- Laggards are anchored by Utilities with near-zero momentum at 0.033 (rank 10 YTD), followed by Real Estate at 0.233 (rank 8 YTD) and Consumer Cyclical at 0.250 (rank 11 YTD).

## Divergences
- Communication Services holds all-green status with solid momentum (0.650) despite lagging in broader performance at rank 9 YTD.
- Energy commands the top YTD rank (rank 1) and robust momentum (0.667), yet fails to qualify for all-green status alongside Technology and Communication Services.
- Basic Materials holds a strong YTD position at rank 3 despite middle-of-the-pack momentum of 0.550.

rotation_phase.label: Mid Cycle
rotation_phase.reasoning: Technology is the sustained momentum leader with an all-green breadth profile alongside positive momentum in Basic Materials, aligning with a mid-cycle expansion pattern despite mixed defensive and late-cycle signals.

risk_radar.relative_strength: Technology is the sole sector genuinely beating the S&P 500, posting a perfect rs_score of 1.00 and rs_confirmed of 1.00 while outperforming SPY across all 7/7 timeframes. No other sectors show confirmed strength, with Energy and Communication Services lagging behind at an rs_score of 0.50 (rs_confirmed 0.17, beating SPY on 3/7 timeframes), and no RS new highs or crosses are reported.
risk_radar.risks:
- Crowded and isolated leadership is evident as Technology is the only sector displaying broad outperformance (rs_score 1.00, beats SPY on 7/7 timeframes), leaving the broader market heavily dependent on a single group.
- Energy exhibits fading directional consistency with an rs_score of 0.50 (beating SPY on 3/7 timeframes) dropping sharply to an rs_confirmed of just 0.17.
- Communication Services shows a similar fragile setup, where its rs_score of 0.50 across 3/7 timeframes deteriorates to an rs_confirmed of 0.17.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** High-momentum technology and healthcare maintain broad leadership, while rapid short-term rotation lifts beaten-down cyclicals and pressures transport, agriculture, and paper.

Market leadership remains heavily concentrated, with only 8 of 144 groups qualifying as all-green across all evaluated timeframes. Dominance continues to sit squarely in hardware and computing niches—led by Semiconductors (0.94 momentum), Computer Hardware (0.94), and Electronics & Computer Distribution (0.94)—alongside Diagnostics & Research (0.92). Sustained strength across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons also highlights broader persistence in groups like Internet Content & Information (0.82) and Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing.

Simultaneously, a sharp tactical rotation is lifting lagging consumer and industrial pockets. Airlines (+20 spots to rank 84) and Real Estate - Diversified (+20 spots to rank 85) showed significant 5-day rank improvement, while low-momentum cyclicals like Apparel Retail and Residential Construction are breaking higher. In contrast, sharp deterioration hit Integrated Freight & Logistics (-18 spots) and Paper & Paper Products (-16 spots), alongside weakening breadth in agricultural inputs and precious metals.

## Strength
- **Narrow All-Green Breadth:** Just 8 of 144 groups are positive across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD windows, led by Semiconductors (momentum 0.94), Computer Hardware (0.94), Electronics & Computer Distribution (0.94), and Diagnostics & Research (0.92).
- **Core Multi-Month Leadership:** Sustained top-36 performance across 1-, 3-, and 6-month ranks is held by Semiconductors, Computer Hardware, Electronics & Computer Distribution, Diagnostics & Research, Consumer Electronics (0.88), Health Information Services (0.84), Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing, and Internet Content & Information (0.82).
- **Software and Consumer Tech Resilience:** Software - Infrastructure (momentum 0.82) and Consumer Electronics (momentum 0.88) continue to post consistent all-green breadth signals.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Top 5-Day Rank Advancers:** Airlines jumped +20 spots (rank 84, momentum 0.64), Real Estate - Diversified surged +20 spots (rank 85, momentum 0.65), and Diagnostics & Research climbed +14 spots (rank 31, momentum 0.92).
- **Sharpest Deterioration:** Integrated Freight & Logistics fell -18 spots (rank 69, momentum 0.34), Paper & Paper Products shed -16 spots (rank 111, momentum 0.40), and Agricultural Inputs declined -14 spots (rank 39, momentum 0.46).
- **Absolute Momentum Extremes:** Top-ranked momentum resides in Semiconductors (0.944, rank_ytd 7) and Computer Hardware (0.942, rank_ytd 1), while absolute laggards include Solar (0.059, rank_ytd 137), Gambling (0.073, rank_ytd 143), and Personal Services (0.082, rank_ytd 138).

## Divergences
- **Fading High-Momentum Groups:** Banks - Diversified (momentum 0.73, -2 spots in 5d), Insurance - Life (momentum 0.67, -3 spots), and Silver (momentum 0.68, -2 spots) are showing early signs of momentum fatigue.
- **Emerging Bottom-Fishers:** Rapid rank gains from weak momentum bases include Apparel Retail (+11 spots, momentum 0.44), Residential Construction (+11 spots, momentum 0.40), and Apparel Manufacturing (+6 spots, momentum 0.33).
- **Energy and Healthcare Splits:** While Diagnostics & Research surges, Healthcare Plans is slipping (-4 spots in 5d, momentum 0.61); similarly, Oil & Gas Equipment & Services is fading (-2 spots in 5d, momentum 0.65) despite sustained strength in refining.

industries.watchlist:
- Department Stores - Watch for confirmation of the RS cross trigger by holding outperformance against SPY on expanding volume; invalidated if the relative strength line falls back below zero vs SPY.
- Farm & Heavy Construction Machinery - Monitor for immediate follow-through above prior pivot highs to confirm the RS cross trigger, while a slip back into negative relative strength vs SPY invalidates the early rotation.
- Airports & Air Services - Track whether relative performance sustains above the breakout level to confirm the RS new high trigger; invalidated if RS drops back below its 20-session high resistance.
- Building Products & Equipment - Watch for sustained upside momentum confirming the RS new high trigger, invalidated if relative strength fails to hold this new 20-session peak and suffers a quick reversal.
- Apparel Retail - Look for continued upside rank velocity and acceleration to confirm the emerging trigger into leadership; invalidated if momentum stalls and acceleration turns negative.

risk_radar.relative_strength: Electronics & Computer Distribution, Consumer Electronics, and Semiconductors lead broad outperformance with perfect rs_scores and rs_confirmed ratings of 1.00 beating SPY on 7/7 timeframes, alongside Diagnostics & Research at 1.00 rs_score and 1.00 rs_confirmed beating on 6/7 timeframes. Fresh leadership signals include RS 20-session new highs in industries like Airports & Air Services, Footwear & Accessories, and Semiconductor Equipment & Materials, with the latter also posting an RS cross alongside Department Stores, Farm & Heavy Construction Machinery, Oil & Gas Integrated, and Scientific & Technical Instruments.
risk_radar.risks:
* Healthcare Plans and Insurance - Life display fading momentum profiles, pairing strong absolute momentum (0.61 and 0.67, respectively) with deteriorating rank changes over the past 5 days (-4 and -3).
* Banks - Diversified (momentum 0.73, rank -2 in 5d), Silver (momentum 0.68, rank -2 in 5d), and Oil & Gas Equipment & Services (momentum 0.65, rank -2 in 5d) show momentum fatigue as short-term rankings slip despite elevated momentum readings.
* Electronic Components and Electrical Equipment & Parts exhibit fragile underlying relative strength, beating SPY on 6/7 timeframes with an rs_score of 0.83 but collapsing to an rs_confirmed score of just 0.28.
